home.heroSubheadline: A privacy-preserving geocaching protocol on Ethereum. Earn verifiable credentials without revealing who you are. Tip the cultural institutions that make Prague special.
home.feat1Body: Solve a quiz at a Prague cultural site. A zero-knowledge proof verifies you were there.
home.feat2Body: The chain knows a legitimate visit happened. It never learns who you are.
home.feat3Body: Tip the institutions that steward Prague's cultural heritage, directly on-chain.
home.step1: Sign in with Google. We give you a wallet automatically.
home.step2: Pick a cache. Walk to the location and scan the QR code.
home.step3: Answer three quick questions about Czech history.
home.step4: Claim your credential. Optionally tip the institution.
